部署紹介/Business Unit
当社の「クラウド＆スマート・インダストリー・グループ（CSIG）」は、クラウドおよびインダストリー・インターネット戦略の推進を担い、クラウド技術、AI、ネットワークセキュリティの進化を通じて、スマート産業の革新的なソリューションを生み出しています。CSIG は、小売、医療、教育、交通など多様な産業のデジタル化を推進しながら、企業がより効率的にユーザーにサービスを提供できるよう支援しています。また、企業とユーザーを結びつける新たなインテリジェント産業エコシステムの構築にも取り組んでいます。
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
As a Senior Solution Architect at Tencent Cloud in Tokyo, Japan, you will play a critical role in designing and delivering tailored cloud solutions for clients across various industries. Your expertise in cloud computing and system architecture will enable you to address complex business challenges and industry-specific needs. Acting as a key liaison between customers and our backend team, you will ensure clear communication, efficient project execution, and client satisfaction. Additionally, you will represent Tencent Cloud in Japan's dynamic technology ecosystem, participating in industry events to enhance our brand presence and influence.
岗位概述
作为腾讯云日本东京的资深解决方案架构师，您将扮演关键角色，为跨行业客户量身设计和交付云端解决方案。凭借在云计算和系统架构领域的专业积淀，您将助力客户应对复杂的商业挑战与行业特定需求。作为客户与后端团队的重要桥梁，您需确保沟通顺畅、项目高效推进，并最终实现客户满意度提升。同时，您将代表腾讯云积极参与日本活跃的技术生态，通过行业活动提升品牌影响力。Develop and implement customized cloud solutions for clients, driving successful project delivery.
Act as the primary point of communication between clients and the backend team, ensuring alignment on requirements and industry standards while closely tracking project progress.
Participate in local and international industry events, conferences, and workshops (both online and offline) to strengthen Tencent Cloud’s market position in Japan.

岗位职责
 
为客户定制化设计和实施云端解决方案，推动项目成功交付
作为客户与后端团队间的核心沟通枢纽，确保需求与行业标准对齐，并精准追踪项目进展
积极参与线上线下国内外行业活动、技术峰会及研讨会，强化腾讯云在日本市场的品牌影响力

応募資格/Who We Look For
Bachelor’s Degree in a computer-related field.
At least 5 years of experience in public cloud pre-sales, solution architecture, or similar roles.
Expertise in cloud computing technologies, including experience with KVM, Xen, or LxC virtualization.
Solid understanding of system architectures and the ability to address industry-specific ecosystems and business needs.
Professional working proficiency in Japanese is required,Proficiency in Chinese would be highly regarded but is not mandatory.

Experience working with or supporting local enterprises in adopting cloud technologies.
Proactive and dependable, with strong execution abilities and a collaborative mindset.
任职要求 
计算机相关专业本科及以上学历
具备5年以上公有云售前、解决方案架构或相关领域经验
精通云计算技术，熟悉KVM、Xen或LxC等虚拟化技术
扎实的系统架构功底，能够针对行业生态与业务需求提出解决方案
熟练掌握商务日语，中文或英语可作为工作语言。具备出色的本地客户及区域团队沟通能力
熟悉日本市场，尤其在游戏、金融、电商等行业有深厚积累
拥有支持或服务当地企业实施云端技术的实践经验

Business Unit
Corporate Development Group (CDG) as the platform for the company's new business incubation and new business exploration, CDG is responsible for promoting development and innovation for important areas such as financial technology and advertising, as well as marketing services, including payment and financial applications. As a professional support platform, CDG also supports the company and various business groups in strategic planning, investments and mergers, investor relations and corporate global communications, marketing and public relations, and more.

What the Role Entails
Cloud-Native System Development: Assist in building, testing, and maintaining advertising data services on AWS, gaining exposure to technologies like EKS, MSK, and S3.
Large-Scale Data Engineering: Participate in the development and optimization of real-time and batch processing pipelines using Flink, Spark, and HBase to handle massive ad-log flows.
System Reliability & Testing: Write robust unit and integration tests. Assist in monitoring system stability and troubleshooting basic performance bottlenecks under the guidance of senior engineers.
Feature Implementation: Collaborate with the team to implement features that support mission-critical, 24/7 ad-tech operations with high traffic and low latency.
Data Compliance: Support the team in developing technical solutions that enforce strict data isolation and regional compliance for global users.

Who We Look For
Education: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
Backend Foundation: Solid programming skills in Java, with a strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design. Basic knowledge of multithreading and JVM is a plus.
Big Data Interest: Academic or personal project experience with, or a strong desire to learn, big data frameworks (e.g., Flink, Spark, HBase).
Cloud/Infrastructure: Basic understanding of cloud computing concepts. Familiarity with Linux environments, Git, and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) is highly preferred.
Problem Solving: Strong analytical skills with the ability to debug code and solve complex technical problems effectively.
AI-Assisted Development: Familiarity with AI coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT) and a proactive mindset to leverage them for enhancing coding efficiency, generating tests, and debugging.
Industry Interest: A strong interest in the AdTech industry (e.g., Attribution, Tracking, or RTB systems).
Drive & Passion: A passion for exploring new technologies and a proactive, self-driven approach to learning.
Communication: Good communication skills in English and/or Mandarin to collaborate effectively with cross-border teams.

Posts.Responsibility:
团队介绍
Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。
Level Infinite为合作工作室提供一系列支持及服务，助力其释放产品潜能。
Level Infinite发行产品包括《PUBG MOBILE》、《Goddess of Victory: NIKKE 》《Honor of King》等热门游戏，并与合作工作室联手推出了来自Fatshark的《战锤40K：暗潮》、Funcom的《沙丘：觉醒》、Inflexion Studios的《夜莺》在内多款产品。
想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责
We are seeking a highly analytical and data-driven business strategy and financial analytics expert to join our IEG Global Strategy Management team. This role will focus on driving business performance analysis for our gaming studios, supporting strategic decision-making through deep gaming insights, and helping shape the future of Tencent’s global gaming business.
You will work closely with studio leaders, cross-functional teams, and senior executives to evaluate performance, identify growth opportunities, and optimize operational efficiency. The ideal candidate combines strong strategic acumen with hands-on analytical capabilities and a genuine passion for gaming.Business Performance Analysis: Lead in-depth analysis of gaming studio performance, including user engagement, monetization trends, content performance, and operational KPIs. Conduct monthly business performance reviews with IEG Global executives, providing data-backed analysis and recommendations
Business Planning: Support the development of annual and long-term business plans for Tencent’s global gaming studios (IEG Global), including contribution to annual reports for Tencent Group executive office
Financial Management: Support budgeting and P&L analysis of studio business, identify margin improvement opportunities and ensure efficient resource allocation across studios

岗位要求
Strong analytics background with hands-on experience in gaming data analysis, user behavior metrics, and business performance modeling
Deep interest in and experience in the global gaming industry. Experience in top global gaming company is a strongly preferred
Strong communication and presentation skills, with experience influencing senior executives and cross-functional stakeholders
Excellent problem-solving skills with high attention to detail and ability to synthesize complex data into clear strategic narratives
Fluency in English and Mandarin (written and verbal) is required.

腾讯致力于提供平等就业机会
在腾讯，我们始终秉承平等就业机会的原则，致力于为每一位员工打造公平、包容的工作环境。我们坚信，多元的声音能够激发出无限的创新活力，推动我们为用户和社会提供更优质的服务。我们用心营造一个充满支持与激励的氛围，帮助每一位员工找到属于自己的舞台，以实现个人及共同的发展目标。

Posts.RecruitPostName: 休闲创意素材 PM
Posts.Responsibility:
团队介绍
Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。
Level Infinite为合作工作室提供一系列支持及服务，助力其释放产品潜能。
Level Infinite发行产品包括《PUBG MOBILE》、《Goddess of Victory: NIKKE 》《Honor of King》等热门游戏，并与合作工作室联手推出了来自Fatshark的《战锤40K：暗潮》、Funcom的《沙丘：觉醒》、Inflexion Studios的《夜莺》在内多款产品。
想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责
1、休闲品类增长策略： 负责全球休闲游戏（含合成、消除、益智等）的素材创意策略。制定从“吸睛点（Hook）”构思、制作监修到交付的全链路方案，确保素材具备极强的全球化传播力和转化力。
2、全球趋势研判： 实时洞察欧美、东南亚等核心市场的休闲素材风向（如真人解说、ASMR、反转剧情、解谜互动等）。前瞻性引入新形式，确保团队在素材表现力上领先竞对。
3、数据驱动迭代： 深度分析广告后台数据（如 CTR、IVR、CPI），从海量数据中剥离出“爆款基因”；建立素材标签体系，通过科学的 A/B Test 持续优化素材生命周期，建立可复用的休闲素材库。
4、AI 工作流整合： 推动 AI 工具在休闲素材生产中的应用。利用 AI 快速产出海量测试原画、背景及视频片段，大幅降低单条素材的试错成本。
5、跨部门协同与 PM： 协调投放、设计及外部供应商资源。通过标准化流程解决休闲业务高频、大量的交付需求，确保项目在高速迭代中保持高质量产出。

岗位要求
1、行业深耕： 5 年以上游戏创意经验，2 年以上团队或 千万级月流水项目管理经验；有完整的休闲游戏（Casual/Hyper-casual）出海成功经验者优先。
2、休闲爆款嗅觉： 极强的市场敏锐度，能精准捕捉休闲用户的心理“爽点”；熟悉 Google, Meta, TikTok, AppLovin 等主流媒体对休闲素材的适配偏好。
3、数据逻辑： 具备优秀的数据拆解能力，不只看结果，更能通过数据反推创意优化路径，对最终的获客成本（CPI）和用户质量（LTV）有深刻理解。
4、项目统筹： 极强的抗压能力和多线程管理能力，能在高强度、快节奏的任务流中精准把控节点，对交付速度和创意质量双重负责。
